label: VRRP
notes: VRRPv2 over IPv4 (protocol 112), the open first-hop redundancy protocol. Only the 8-byte fixed prefix sits at fixed offsets: the virtual router's IP address list (RFC 3768 §5.3.9) follows with a count-dependent length, and the RFC 2338-era authentication data words (§5.3.10) follow the addresses, so neither is modelled. VRRPv3 (RFC 5798) reuses protocol 112 with a different layout after byte 4 and is not covered by this entry.

fields.label: Version
fields.description: VRRP protocol version; 2 in every VRRPv2 advertisement.

fields.label: Virtual Router ID
fields.description: Identifies the virtual router on this LAN.

fields.label: Priority
fields.description: 255 = IP address owner, 100 = default backup priority, 0 = master releasing the virtual router.

fields.label: Count IP Addrs
fields.description: Number of IP addresses carried after the fixed header.

fields.label: Auth Type
fields.description: 0 = No Authentication; 1 and 2 are reserved for RFC 2338 compatibility.

fields.label: Advertisement Interval
fields.description: Seconds between advertisements; the default is 1.
